caption: The drawing depicts two hand fan designs on a plain, light beige background. The upper fan is a sketch in grayscale, featuring an arc with light decorative floral patterns on the sides and a landscape scene with trees and a body of water in the center. The lower fan is fully colored and open, with the fan leaf decorated in a variety of colors including pink, red, green, blue, yellow, and mauve. It shows a group of people dressed in elaborate period clothing, gathered outdoors in a garden-like setting, surrounded by trees. The edges and side panels of the fan leaf have intricate red and gold patterns with some floral motifs. The sticks of the fan, visible at the bottom, are decorated with symmetrical black or dark gray designs. Both fans are semicircular in shape, with the colored one oriented below the grayscale sketch.
title: Fan
